# Compile to HTML/JS produces output file.
sngl compile --lang=js --platform=html --out=out app.sngl
stdout 'out/index.html'
exists out/index.html

# --lang without --platform is an error.
! sngl compile --lang=js app.sngl

# --platform without --lang is an error.
! sngl compile --platform=html app.sngl

# Unknown language.
! sngl compile --lang=cobol --platform=html app.sngl

# Unknown platform.
! sngl compile --lang=js --platform=dos app.sngl

# No files found.
! sngl compile --lang=js --platform=html empty/

# Parse error.
! sngl compile --lang=js --platform=html bad.sngl

# Quiet mode suppresses filename output.
sngl compile --lang=js --platform=html --out=out2 -q app.sngl
! stdout .

-- app.sngl --
component main {
    var count = 0
    button(text="+", @click={ count += 1 })
    text(value="Count: {count}")
}
-- bad.sngl --
not valid sngl
-- empty/.gitkeep --
